description_en: Queries the carrier information of a phone number, including the province, city, basic carrier (China Mobile, China Unicom, China Telecom, or China Broadnet), mobile virtual network operator (such as Alibaba Cloud Communication), whether the number has been ported, and the number segment
description_zh: 查询手机号码的归属信息，包括：所属省份、所属城市、所属基础运营商（中国移动、中国联通、中国电信、中国广电）、移动转售企业（阿里通信等）、是否携号转网、归属号码段等
kebab_example: aliyun dytnsapi describe-phone-number-operator-attribute --input-number 13900001234 --auth-code Dd1r0004id --mask MD5 --api-version 2020-02-17 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribePhoneNumberOperatorAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The phone number that you want to query.

If Mask is set to NORMAL, this field is an 11-digit phone number.
If Mask is set to MD5, this field is a 32-character encrypted string.
If Mask is set to SHA256, this field is a 64-character encrypted string.
If Mask is set to SM3, this field is a 64-character encrypted string.

<notice>The letters in the encrypted string are not case-sensitive.</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
待查询的号码。

若Mask取值为NORMAL，该字段为11位手机号码。
若Mask取值为MD5，该字段为32位加密字符串。
若Mask取值为SHA256，该字段为64位加密字符串。
若Mask取值为SM3，该字段为64位加密字符串。

<notice>加密字符串中字母不区分大小写。</notice>
parameters.name: input_number

parameters.help_en:
The authorization code.

On the My Applications page of the Cell Phone Number Service console (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/apply), obtain the authorization ID, which is the authorization code
parameters.help_zh:
授权码。

在号码百科控制台 (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/apply)我的申请页面，获取授权ID即授权码
parameters.name: auth_code

parameters.help_en:
The encryption method of the phone number. Valid values:

NORMAL: no encryption
MD5: MD5 encryption
SHA256: SHA256 encryption
SM3: SM3 encryption

<notice>All letters in the string must be uppercase.</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
号码的加密方式。取值：

NORMAL：不加密
MD5：MD5加密
SHA256：SHA256加密
SM3：SM3加密

<notice>字符串中所有字母必须大写。</notice>
parameters.name: mask

parameters.help_en: A system parameter. You do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.name: flow_name

parameters.help_en: A system parameter. You do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.name: result_count

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details about the access denial. This parameter is returned only if the request is denied because the RAM user or RAM role does not have the required permissions
AccessDeniedDetail.description_zh: 访问被拒绝详细信息；只有RAM校验失败才会返回此字段

Code.description_en:
The status code of the request. Valid values:

OK: The request is successful.
InvalidParameter: The phone number is invalid or the format of the parameter is invalid.
PhoneNumberNotfound: The carrier information of the phone number is not found.
isp.UNKNOWN: An unknown error occurred.
RequestFrequencyLimit: Due to carrier restrictions, you cannot frequently query the same number in a short period of time. If this error code is returned, try again later
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。取值：

OK：成功。
InvalidParameter：传入的手机号错误或参数格式错误。
PhoneNumberNotfound：传入的手机号查不到归属结果。
isp.UNKNOWN：未知异常。
RequestFrequencyLimit：因运营商限制，禁止在短时间内高频对同一个号码进行反复查询，如返回此错误码，请您稍后再试

BasicCarrier.description_en:
The basic carrier. Valid values:

China Mobile.
China Unicom.
China Telecom.
China Broadnet
BasicCarrier.description_zh:
基础运营商。取值：

中国移动。
中国联通。
中国电信。
中国广电

Carrier.description_en: The actual carrier (including the mobile virtual network operator). If number portability is enabled, the value indicates the carrier after number portability
Carrier.description_zh: 实际运营商（含虚拟运营商），如果存在携号转网，则为携转后的运营商

City.description_en: The city to which the phone number belongs

IsNumberPortability.description_en:
Indicates whether the number has been ported. Valid values:

true: yes

false: no
IsNumberPortability.description_zh:
是否携号转网。取值：

true：是

false：否

NumberSegment.description_en: The number segment to which the phone number belongs

Province.description_en: The province to which the phone number belongs

Message.description_en: The description of the status code
